headline: Start Colston Loveland over Brock Bowers
reasoning: Bowers being DOUBTFUL is the clearest signal on this roster: when a starter has meaningful odds of not dressing, you don't ride it out hoping for the best. Loveland steps in cleanly at TE, and as a Bear he even gets the Home Turf bonus — though honestly the injury flag alone is enough to pull the trigger here. Everything else on the lineup looks solid; Jonathon Brooks is Questionable but there's no healthy RB on the bench to replace him with (Henderson is OUT, Croskey-Merritt is also Questionable and in the flex), so that one's a hold-and-monitor.

headline: No waiver move this week
reasoning: The top arbitrage signals are all QBs (Willis 34.9, Stroud 34.4, Darnold 24.3), but single-QB leagues make a second quarterback a luxury we explicitly don't spend on — Lamar Jackson is already locked in, so those gaps aren't exploitable here. The remaining free agents either have negative arbitrage scores, project to low point totals at positions already covered (K, WR depth), or don't clearly upgrade any roster spot worth touching. No real edge available this week.
